note: SIMULATED learners only (seeded models); not evidence about real children or real learning gains. Branch research/deep-recovery-confidence (from 311f9d31).

fr_analysis.what: the 68 phase-4 held-out false-reassurance runs re-run (68/68 reproduce): 36 lucky typed first try, 24 two lucky typed after help, 8 two lucky typed at the slip check; no claim rested on a choice item

rules: selective (phase-4 P4 options, current) | three-fresh | different-form | delayed-add | delayed-replace | delayed-first | consistent | consistent-first; all with sessionBudget 40, budget 120, max 3 sittings, reuse on, validDays 7 (frontend/src/journey/deep-recovery-sim5.ts RULES)
learners: per goal O1 (gen:aupfr) and O2 (gen:aulax): strong-right, strong-slips, strong-history, single-gap, multiple-gaps, light-guesser (lucky: typed 5%, choice 25%), heavy-guesser (typed 20%, choice 30%; a stress assumption)

seeds.tuning: 5001-5010: six rules at 3f6da082 (tuning-seeds-5001-5010-six-rules-at-3f6da082.jsonl, 840 runs) + consistent/consistent-first added after it (tuning-seeds-5001-5010-consistent-rules.jsonl, 280 runs)
seeds.heldout: 6001-6030 at 9dfa0b03 (heldout-seeds-6001-6030-at-9dfa0b03.jsonl, 3360 runs = 14 cells x 8 rules x 30, 0 errors); never used for any change

outcomes: solved-fresh-unaided (claims solved and the learner model can do the goal) | false-reassurance | provisional (still owed a later-sitting check after 3 sittings) | pause | blocked | handed-over | error
known_caveat: simulated wrong answers on tuple items (partial fractions, linear systems) are '0' (shared learners.ts wrong()); the node grader marks them wrong, the real server would treat them as unreadable and re-ask. Decisions and rule comparisons are unaffected (rules differ only on goal answers); absolute O1 effort is not server-realistic.
